text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle that frames the pledge declaration as asserted news
words.prose: The word {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) does not narrate a scene; it asserts the pledge reality as weighty news after the obligation frame of 48:9. That opening force prepares the restrictive redirection that follows, so the human pledge will be received inside a strengthened legal-metaphysical frame.

topics.headline: emphatic declarative opening
topics.summary: The reader notices that the pledge equation begins as a strengthened declaration after the obligation frame of 48:9, before any consequence is discussed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pledge equation begins as a strengthened declaration after the obligation frame of 48:9, before any consequence is discussed.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the QAC analysis of an emphatic particle governing the opening clause.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun forming an action-defined pledging class
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the actors a definite relative class before the pledge is reinterpreted. After the direct address of 48:9, the grammar presents those characterized by the act, then the following repetition redirects what their act truly reaches.

topics.headline: class defined by pledge action
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah turns the direct obligations of 48:9 into a repeatable class of people defined by pledging, not by named individuals.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns the direct obligations of 48:9 into a repeatable class of people defined by pledging, not by named individuals.
topics.reason: The rows fit the relative-pronoun syntax and preserve the shift from direct address to third-person classification.

words.gloss_range: Form III imperfect pledge with second-person object suffix; reciprocal allegiance framed as binding exchange
words.root_gloss_range: sale, exchange, and pledge fields; here the Form III pledge activates a reciprocal compact rather than ordinary commerce alone
words.prose: {{ar:يُبَايِعُونَكَ}} ({{tr:yubāyiʿūnaka}}), from {{ar:ب ي ع}} ({{tr:b-y-ʿ}}), carries the sale-and-pledge field into a Form III reciprocal act and attaches the addressee inside the word. The payoff is not ordinary buying and selling by itself, but a binding allegiance transaction whose visible recipient is about to be reidentified; the same pledge-commerce field is clarified by the price-and-return logic of 9:111 and the pledge scene of 48:18.

topics.headline: visible addressee in reciprocal pledge
topics.summary: The reader notices that the first pledge verb makes the addressee visibly receive a reciprocal transaction and places this pledge in a wider divine-commerce arc (9:111; 48:18).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first pledge verb makes the addressee visibly receive a reciprocal transaction and places this pledge in a wider divine-commerce arc (9:111; 48:18).
topics.reason: Commercial-root and reciprocity rows survive, while local grammar narrows them to pledge allegiance rather than ordinary sale.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle that redirects the pledge from visible addressee to God alone
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) is the hinge between the two pledge verbs. It does more than emphasize: it restricts the true destination of the same action, making the addressee transparent to God as ultimate counterparty.

topics.headline: restriction performs recipient transfer
topics.summary: The reader notices that restriction is the mechanism that makes pledging the messenger count as pledging God, excluding an independent final human counterparty.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that restriction is the mechanism that makes pledging the messenger count as pledging God, excluding an independent final human counterparty.
topics.reason: The rows agree with the restrictive-particle analysis and its position between repeated pledge verbs.

words.gloss_range: repeated Form III imperfect pledge, now without the suffix and with God as object
words.root_gloss_range: sale, exchange, and pledge fields; here the repeated Form III verb is narrowed to the divine counterparty of the pledge
words.prose: {{ar:يُبَايِعُونَ}} ({{tr:yubāyiʿūna}}), again from {{ar:ب ي ع}} ({{tr:b-y-ʿ}}), repeats the reciprocal pledge action without the second-person suffix. The unchanged verb and changed object keep the compact continuous while assigning its true counterparty to God.

topics.headline: same action reassigned to God
topics.summary: The reader notices that the verb stays the same while its object changes, so the text enacts transfer rather than replacing the action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb stays the same while its object changes, so the text enacts transfer rather than replacing the action.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the repeated imperfect Form III verb and its direct-object relation to the following divine name.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in accusative object position as true pledge recipient
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with worship and deity associations; here it functions as the proper-name object receiving the pledge
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}), with root display {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}), stands as the accusative object of the repeated pledge verb. Variant evidence shows a beneficiary reading was imaginable, but the local standard form makes God the counterparty who receives the pledge itself; the same divine party is also the giver in the obedience-reward pattern of 48:16.

topics.headline: God as direct pledge object
topics.summary: The reader notices that the standard case makes God the direct recipient of the pledge, not merely the beneficiary, and that this same divine counterparty is tied to reward delivery (48:16).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard case makes God the direct recipient of the pledge, not merely the beneficiary, and that this same divine counterparty is tied to reward delivery (48:16).
topics.reason: Direct-object rows survive; derivational and variant rows are narrowed by the local accusative object syntax.

words.gloss_range: construct-head hand in a verbless assertion of divine agency above the pledged hands
words.root_gloss_range: hand, agency, power, and support fields; here the construct phrase selects divine agency over the pledged hands
words.prose: {{ar:يَدُ}} ({{tr:yadu}}), from {{ar:ي د ي}} ({{tr:y-d-y}}), begins the nominal hand statement. The concrete hand image supplies agency and support, while the construct with the divine name and the verbless clause keep the local payoff as standing divine superiority over the pledge, not a generic hand image. Its parenthetical placement makes divine agency the explanatory center before breach and fulfillment, and 48:24 later shifts the same hand field from pledge superiority to restrained hostile hands.

topics.headline: divine hand as standing superior agency
topics.summary: The reader notices that the hand image is grammatically definite, interrupts the pledge logic as a power-declaration, and links pledge hands to later restrained hands (48:24).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hand image is grammatically definite, interrupts the pledge logic as a power-declaration, and links pledge hands to later restrained hands (48:24).
topics.reason: Metonymic hand and construct rows survive, narrowed by the local nominal clause and divine-possessor grammar.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine proper name that makes the hand phrase specifically God’s
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field; here the genitive proper name defines the possessor in the construct hand phrase
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), with root display {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}), is the genitive possessor in the hand construct. Its case turns the preceding hand into God’s own agency and keeps the three divine-name occurrences moving through pledge object, hand possessor, and covenant counterparty.

topics.headline: possessor fixes the hand phrase
topics.summary: The reader notices that the genitive divine name makes the hand phrase specific to God and links this middle assertion back to the pledge recipient.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the genitive divine name makes the hand phrase specific to God and links this middle assertion back to the pledge recipient.
topics.reason: The rows fit the genitive construct role and the ayah-internal recurrence of the divine name.

words.gloss_range: place adverb functioning as predicate, marking superiority over the participants hands
words.root_gloss_range: above, over, superiority, and upper relation; here the spatial adverb serves the standing predicate of superiority
words.prose: {{ar:فَوْقَ}} ({{tr:fawqa}}), from {{ar:ف و ق}} ({{tr:f-w-q}}), supplies the predicate of the nominal sentence. Its spatial sense becomes a relation of superiority and oversight, placing the divine hand over the human hands within the pledge image and converting the reverential weight of 48:9 into structural overness.

topics.headline: above as predicate of superiority
topics.summary: The reader notices that above is not loose scenery; it is the predicate that turns the reverence-weight of 48:9 into a settled hierarchy over the pledged hands.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that above is not loose scenery; it is the predicate that turns the reverence-weight of 48:9 into a settled hierarchy over the pledged hands.
topics.reason: The rows align with QAC adverbial predicate syntax and the local hand-over-hands relation.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed hands of the pledgers under the divine hand
words.root_gloss_range: hand, possession, agency, and pledged hands; here the plural possessed form marks the participants hands under the divine hand
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْدِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:aydīhim}}), from {{ar:ي د ي}} ({{tr:y-d-y}}), names the participants’ plural hands with a possessive suffix. The form keeps the pledge scene embodied and collective, while the preceding above phrase makes those hands subordinate to the singular divine hand; 48:24 later contrasts pledged hands under God’s hand with hands restrained from aggression.

topics.headline: their hands as pledged participants
topics.summary: The reader notices the contrast between the singular divine hand and the plural possessed human hands, with the same hand field later showing divine control through restraint (48:24).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between the singular divine hand and the plural possessed human hands, with the same hand field later showing divine control through restraint (48:24).
topics.reason: Plural hand, suffix, and contrast rows survive, narrowed to the local pledge-hands image.

words.gloss_range: consequential conjunction opening the breach conditional
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns from the pledge assertion into conditional consequence. It links the declared divine pledge relation to the accountability that follows, opening the breach branch.

topics.headline: consequence follows pledge declaration
topics.summary: The reader notices that the first consequence is grammatically attached to the pledge declaration rather than introduced as a separate topic.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first consequence is grammatically attached to the pledge declaration rather than introduced as a separate topic.
topics.reason: The rows match the conjunction’s role before the first conditional.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever, opening an individualizing breach case
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) makes the breach case open-ended: whoever breaks becomes the test case. The relative class from the opening is now individualized into a conditional subject.

topics.headline: whoever universalizes breach accountability
topics.summary: The reader notices that the warning applies to any member of the pledging class, not only the original scene.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning applies to any member of the pledging class, not only the original scene.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the conditional particle analysis and its structural role before the breach verb.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect breach verb, rooted in breaking or unraveling a binding thing
words.root_gloss_range: undoing, breaking, and unraveling a binding thing; here the breach of pledge is selected without an explicit object
words.prose: {{ar:نَكَثَ}} ({{tr:nakatha}}), from {{ar:ن ك ث}} ({{tr:n-k-th}}), makes breach sound like breaking or unraveling a binding, down to the loose-fiber field visible in 16:92. The local construction has no explicit object, so the pledge frame supplies what is being broken, while 9:12 makes the oath-and-covenant field explicit; this unraveling pole will be answered by fulfillment as completion.

topics.headline: breach as broken binding
topics.summary: The reader notices that breach is pictured as unraveling a compact, with the omitted object supplied by the pledge frame and the oath-breaking field made explicit elsewhere (9:12; 16:92).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that breach is pictured as unraveling a compact, with the omitted object supplied by the pledge frame and the oath-breaking field made explicit elsewhere (9:12; 16:92).
topics.reason: Root-image rows survive, while valency evidence narrows the verb to an intransitive conditional breach supplied by context.

words.gloss_range: resultative conjunction introducing the breach apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the answer to the breach condition. It keeps the movement tight: once breach is named, the consequence clause is immediately attached.

topics.headline: breach answer marker
topics.summary: The reader notices that the harm clause is the direct answer to the act of breach.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harm clause is the direct answer to the act of breach.
topics.reason: The rows align with the apodosis-introducing conjunction before the restrictive harm clause.

words.gloss_range: second restrictive particle limiting breach damage to the self
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) repeats the restriction mechanism at the consequence point. The first restriction transferred the pledge upward; this second one confines the damage of breach inward to the breaker.

topics.headline: restriction makes harm rebound inward
topics.summary: The reader notices that the second restriction mirrors the first: the pledge goes upward to God, while breach damage is restricted back onto the breaker.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second restriction mirrors the first: the pledge goes upward to God, while breach damage is restricted back onto the breaker.
topics.reason: The rows cohere around the second restrictive particle and its mirror relation to the first restriction.

words.gloss_range: imperfect breach verb repeating the root as ongoing rebound against the self
words.root_gloss_range: undoing, breaking, and unraveling a binding thing; here the same root returns as the ongoing consequence of breach
words.prose: {{ar:يَنكُثُ}} ({{tr:yankuthu}}), from {{ar:ن ك ث}} ({{tr:n-k-th}}), repeats the breach root in the apodosis. The perfect breach event is answered by an imperfect consequence, so the act of breaking is recast as ongoing damage that returns onto its doer; related imperfect uses after relief in 7:135 and 43:50 sharpen the sense of repeated reneging after benefit.

topics.headline: repeated breach becomes self-directed consequence
topics.summary: The reader notices that the same breaking root returns as ongoing self-harm, with other imperfect uses after relief sharpening the pattern of reneging (7:135; 43:50).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same breaking root returns as ongoing self-harm, with other imperfect uses after relief sharpening the pattern of reneging (7:135; 43:50).
topics.reason: The repeated-root and aspect rows survive, narrowed by the following prepositional phrase against the self.

words.gloss_range: preposition directing the consequence against the self
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) gives the rebound its target. The preposition turns the consequence into pressure against the self that follows, making breach self-directed in grammar.

topics.headline: against marks rebound target
topics.summary: The reader notices that the damage is directed against the breaker, not outward against God or the pledge community.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the damage is directed against the breaker, not outward against God or the pledge community.
topics.reason: The rows fit the prepositional attachment to the following possessed self.

words.gloss_range: possessed self as the bearer of breach consequence
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, and inner bearer of consequence; here the possessed self receives the rebound of breach
words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسِهِ}} ({{tr:nafsihi}}), from {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}), is the possessed self that receives the consequence. The word can carry person, soul, breath, and selfhood, but here the preposition and suffix narrow it to the breaker as bearer of the rebound; in the wider commerce frame, 9:111 shows selves as what God purchases, while this clause shows the breacher damaging his own self.

topics.headline: self bears the breach
topics.summary: The reader notices that breach lands on the breaker’s own possessed self, the negative side of the same self-as-transaction field made explicit in 9:111.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that breach lands on the breaker’s own possessed self, the negative side of the same self-as-transaction field made explicit in 9:111.
topics.reason: Selfhood rows survive, while local syntax narrows the payoff to the possessed self governed by against.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction opening the parallel fulfillment condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second conditional with the first. It opens the fulfillment branch as the positive counterpart to the breach branch, turning the totality frame of 48:9 into two moral alternatives.

topics.headline: positive branch coordinates with breach branch
topics.summary: The reader notices that the reward path is coordinated as the matching alternative to breach, turning the totality frame of 48:9 into a moral binary.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward path is coordinated as the matching alternative to breach, turning the totality frame of 48:9 into a moral binary.
topics.reason: The rows match coordination between the two conditional structures.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever, opening the individual fulfillment case
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) repeats the open conditional subject for the positive side. The ayah does not leave fulfillment as a group abstraction; after the collective obligation frame of 48:9, it makes any fulfiller personally eligible for the promised outcome.

topics.headline: whoever universalizes fulfillment
topics.summary: The reader notices that fulfillment, like breach, is framed for any individual, so the collective obligations of 48:9 become personal accountability.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fulfillment, like breach, is framed for any individual, so the collective obligations of 48:9 become personal accountability.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the conditional particle parallel to the earlier whoever.

words.gloss_range: Form IV fulfillment verb meaning to complete or bring fully due, governing the covenant content through the following preposition
words.root_gloss_range: completion, full measure, and fulfillment; here Form IV with the following preposition selects covenant fulfillment
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْفَى}} ({{tr:awfā}}), from {{ar:و ف ي}} ({{tr:w-f-y}}), makes the positive branch a matter of full completion. The following preposition keeps the verb tied to the covenant content, so the payoff is fulfilled measure within the pledge obligation rather than generic goodness; it answers the unraveling verb as its opposite and resonates with the reciprocal fulfillment language of 9:111.

topics.headline: fulfillment as full completion
topics.summary: The reader notices that the positive act fills the covenant to full measure, standing opposite unraveling and echoing the reciprocal fulfillment question of 9:111.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive act fills the covenant to full measure, standing opposite unraveling and echoing the reciprocal fulfillment question of 9:111.
topics.reason: Completion and fullness rows survive, narrowed by the awfā bi construction and covenant context.

words.gloss_range: preposition binding fulfillment to the covenant content
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the fulfillment verb to what is fulfilled. It makes the next relative phrase the content by which the act of fulfillment is measured.

topics.headline: with marks the fulfilled content
topics.summary: The reader notices that fulfillment is grammatically attached to a specific content, not left as an abstract virtue.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fulfillment is grammatically attached to a specific content, not left as an abstract virtue.
topics.reason: The rows fit the preposition’s role after the fulfillment verb.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun naming the covenantal content to be fulfilled
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the relative content of fulfillment. The word turns the positive condition toward the specific matter covenanted, rather than allowing fulfillment to remain unspecified.

topics.headline: what specifies fulfillment content
topics.summary: The reader notices that the object of fulfillment is the covenanted matter introduced by the relative clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of fulfillment is the covenanted matter introduced by the relative clause.
topics.reason: The rows align with the relative pronoun governed by the preceding preposition.

words.gloss_range: Form III covenant verb, reciprocal and paired with fulfillment
words.root_gloss_range: covenant, undertaking, and mutual binding; here Form III keeps the covenantal act reciprocal while the phrase assigns human accountability before God
words.prose: {{ar:عَاهَدَ}} ({{tr:ʿāhada}}), from {{ar:ع ه د}} ({{tr:ʿ-h-d}}), names the covenanting act that defines what must be fulfilled. Form III keeps mutual obligation visible, and 2:40 models the reciprocal covenant-fulfillment logic that this phrase compresses; the surrounding phrase keeps the standard reading focused on human fulfillment before God even while variant evidence exposes possible agency shifts.

topics.headline: mutual covenant act defines fulfillment
topics.summary: The reader notices that fulfillment is measured by a reciprocal covenant act, modeled by covenant fulfillment in 2:40, while variant agency pressures do not displace standard human accountability before God.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fulfillment is measured by a reciprocal covenant act, modeled by covenant fulfillment in 2:40, while variant agency pressures do not displace standard human accountability before God.
topics.reason: Reciprocal covenant rows survive; variant and agency rows are narrowed by the standard surface and phrase syntax.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus suffix marking the obligation side of the covenant phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهُ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhu}}) fuses the obligation preposition with a third-person suffix. The suffix can be read with some ambiguity, but the local payoff is clear: the covenant phrase marks a burden-bearing side before naming God as the counterparty.

topics.headline: obligation lies upon the covenanter
topics.summary: The reader notices that the covenant is not loose content; it is something laid upon the agent or covenantal matter in the phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the covenant is not loose content; it is something laid upon the agent or covenantal matter in the phrase.
topics.reason: Obligation and complement rows survive, while suffix ambiguity is preserved as local narrowing.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in the covenant phrase, standardly accusative as counterparty while variants expose agency reversal
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field; here case and position make God the covenant counterparty in the standard reading while variants expose an agency contrast
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}), with root display {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}), closes the covenant phrase as the standard accusative divine counterparty. Nominative variant evidence matters because it would reverse agency, but the local surface keeps the human as covenanter before God.

topics.headline: case fixes covenant agency
topics.summary: The reader notices that case decides whether God is covenanted with or made the covenanting subject; the standard form keeps the human accountable before God.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case decides whether God is covenanted with or made the covenanting subject; the standard form keeps the human accountable before God.
topics.reason: Case-and-agency rows survive, narrowed to the standard accusative reading while recording the variant contrast.

words.gloss_range: consequential conjunction introducing the reward apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) introduces the reward answer to the fulfillment condition. Its repeated apodosis role makes the positive outcome structurally as immediate as the earlier breach consequence.

topics.headline: reward follows fulfillment directly
topics.summary: The reader notices that reward is grammatically tied as the answer to fulfilled covenant, mirroring the breach consequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward is grammatically tied as the answer to fulfilled covenant, mirroring the breach consequence.
topics.reason: The rows match the conjunction before the reward verb and its mirror relation to the first apodosis.

words.gloss_range: future Form IV giving verb with recipient suffix, making reward a certain delivered arrival
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving; here Form IV with future marking makes reward arrive to the fulfiller
words.prose: {{ar:سَيُؤْتِيهِ}} ({{tr:sayuʾtīhi}}), from {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}), stacks future marking, Form IV causative giving, and a recipient suffix into one reward verb. Variant voice and hamza rows mark a recitational pressure point, but the local payoff remains certain delivered arrival to the fulfiller; 4:152 supplies a giving-wages parallel, while 48:16 repeats the same-surah pattern of divine reward for compliance.

topics.headline: promised reward as delivered arrival
topics.summary: The reader notices that the reward is a future delivered compensation caused to arrive to the fulfiller, with giving-wage parallels and same-surah reward logic sharpening it (4:152; 48:16).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is a future delivered compensation caused to arrive to the fulfiller, with giving-wage parallels and same-surah reward logic sharpening it (4:152; 48:16).
topics.reason: Future, Form IV, delivery, variant, and sound rows survive, narrowed to the local standard word and reward apodosis.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative reward object, compensation delivered in the pledge-commerce frame
words.root_gloss_range: wage, recompense, compensation, and reward; here the accusative object is the delivered compensation for fulfilled covenant
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}), from {{ar:أ ج ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-j-r}}), is the reward object delivered by the giving verb. Its wage-and-compensation field answers the pledge-commerce opening, while its indefinite accusative form lets the compensation remain magnified rather than merely unspecified; the same reward thread recurs in 48:16 and 48:29.

topics.headline: reward as contractual compensation
topics.summary: The reader notices that the delivered thing is wage-like recompense, magnified by indefiniteness and tied to the surah reward thread (48:16; 48:29).
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the delivered thing is wage-like recompense, magnified by indefiniteness and tied to the surah reward thread (48:16; 48:29).
topics.reason: Reward-object, compensation, tanwin, formula, and cadence rows survive, narrowed to the local object of giving.

words.gloss_range: qualitative adjective agreeing with reward and closing the ayah with structural magnitude
words.root_gloss_range: bone, structure, magnitude, and greatness; here the adjective gives the reward structural scale and final weight
words.prose: {{ar:عَظِيمًا}} ({{tr:ʿaẓīman}}), from {{ar:ع ظ م}} ({{tr:ʿ-ẓ-m}}), agrees with the reward noun and closes the ayah. The bone-and-structure root field gives the reward weight and permanence, while the adjective form makes greatness a quality of the promised compensation, not a separate comparison; 48:29 repeats the same great-reward closure, and 48:5 belongs to the same great-outcome thread.

topics.headline: greatness gives reward final weight
topics.summary: The reader notices that the last word locks structural greatness onto the reward, closing the pledge logic with a phrase echoed at 48:29 and linked to great outcomes in 48:5.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word locks structural greatness onto the reward, closing the pledge logic with a phrase echoed at 48:29 and linked to great outcomes in 48:5.
topics.reason: Agreement, root-image, closure, formulaic echo, and cadence rows survive, narrowed to the local adjective modifying reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated يُبَايِعُونَكَ / يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ construction and the paired hands turn one visible act toward the messenger into an act whose ultimate counterparty is God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The allegiance branch supplies the legal-social act, the sale branch keeps reciprocal exchange active, and the hand-to-hand branch gives the transaction a bodily interface. The restrictive إِنَّمَا does the reader-visible transposition: the human addressee receives the act, while God owns its binding force.

activation_trace.role: The obedience-pledge branch makes the repeated act a binding allegiance transaction and supplies the model's public contract.
The sale-and-purchase branch keeps reciprocal exchange latent inside the allegiance formula and makes later reward a settlement rather than an unrelated gift.
The hand-to-hand delivery branch gives the mediated transaction a concrete transfer interface between the visible and ultimate counterparties.

changed_reading.before: The people swear personal loyalty to the messenger and will later be rewarded for keeping it.
changed_reading.after: The visible hand-pledge is a mediated allegiance exchange: it reaches the messenger bodily but binds as a transaction with God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ places one divine hand over the participants' plural hands.
baseline_models.mechanism: The authority-hand and surrender-hand branches form a vertical jurisdiction: the lower hands enact and submit, while the upper hand supplies the commanding sovereignty under which the pledge has force. The dominance branch of ف و ق makes this a hierarchy of agency, not only a spatial tableau.

activation_trace.role: The sovereign-hand branch supplies effective authority to the singular hand above the participants' hands.
The ascendancy branch converts vertical فوق into jurisdiction and governing superiority.
The surrendered-hand branch makes the lower hands signs of submission, guarantee, and pledged liability.

changed_reading.before: God is present as a superior witness to a human ceremony.
changed_reading.after: The ceremony is nested inside divine jurisdiction: the participants' hands act only within the authority of the hand above them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same singular-over-plural hand construction can depict an enabling hand held over a joined body, not only a hand dominating it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of ي د ي preserves a strongly aided power branch alongside the hand's support and benefaction branches. Read together with simple spatial فوق, the upper hand can underwrite, protect, or empower the many lower hands. This coexists with the authority model because support and sovereignty need not exclude one another.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped root's reinforced-power branch activates divine enablement within the hand image.
The supporting-hand branch makes the upper hand a source of aid and collective reinforcement.
The benefaction-hand branch lets superiority include prior grace that enables the pledge and its fulfillment.
The literal vertical branch preserves the covering over-hand arrangement without deciding that its sole function is coercion.

changed_reading.before: The hand above means only that divine power outranks human power.
changed_reading.after: The hand above may simultaneously authorize and strengthen the pledged hands, making fidelity enabled from above rather than merely demanded from above.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ repeats the breach root and directs its effect back onto the breacher's own self.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material image of undoing a cord after it was made firm renders covenant breach as deconstruction. The covenant branch identifies what is undone, while نفس as the thing's own identity makes the reflexive consequence more than external punishment: the breacher loosens the coherence by which that self had become bound.

activation_trace.role: The unravelling-after-twisting branch supplies the material mechanism of breach as self-deconstruction.
The confirmed-covenant breach branch fixes the material unravelling to the pledge rather than to a free-standing textile image.
The safeguarded compact branch identifies the structure whose integrity has been entrusted to the pledger.
The self-as-the-thing-itself branch localizes the unravelled consequence in the agent's own identity and integrity.

changed_reading.before: Breaking the pledge violates an obligation and incurs a penalty.
changed_reading.after: Breaking the pledge unweaves the breacher's own constituted integrity; the divine side of the bond is not what the breach diminishes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ ... فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا moves from covenant maintenance through full performance to a future payment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence is a contract lifecycle rather than a single sincere instant. عهد requires repeated custody, وفى carries the obligation to undiminished completion, and إيتاء plus أجر settles the completed performance as a return on work. عظيم scales the settlement without changing that functional chain.

activation_trace.role: The repeated-care branch makes covenant fidelity an obligation maintained state after state.
The complete-without-deficiency branch supplies the performance threshold that closes the obligation.
The giving branch makes the promised consequence a directed transfer to the fulfiller.
The work-compensation branch frames the transfer as earned settlement while retaining the broader sense of recompense.
The magnitude-and-strength branch marks the settlement as exceeding an ordinary contractual return.

changed_reading.before: A sincere pledge earns a large reward.
changed_reading.after: The pledge initiates durable custody of a compact; complete performance reaches a settlement whose magnitude exceeds the ordinary exchange latent in the pledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَٰهَدَ, يُؤْتِيهِ, and أَجْرًا can form a secondary material chain of recurrent tending, produced yield, and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of عهد pictures rain revisiting already wetted ground, while an إتيان branch names the emergence of crop or fruit yield. The focus verse can therefore carry a latent cultivation analogy: fidelity repeatedly tends what the pledge began until it produces a return. This does not replace the covenant and payment senses; it gives them a temporal-material image.

activation_trace.role: The revisiting-rain branch supplies recurrent tending of ground already made receptive as an analogy for maintained covenant.
The emerging-growth and fruit-yield branch turns the future giving into the production stage of the cultivation analogy.
The return-on-work branch closes the analogy by making cultivated yield consequential rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Covenant keeping is static compliance until reward arrives.
changed_reading.after: Covenant keeping can be pictured as recurrent cultivation whose maintained relation eventually brings forth its own promised yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening root at 48:1 contributes both a beginning that opens what follows and a judicial separation that releases closure. Set before the focus pledge, it lets the compact function as a threshold inside an already opened process: allegiance enters a new field of action and adjudication rather than merely commemorating a finished victory.

activation_trace.role: The allegiance-transaction branch supplies the binding threshold crossed by the pledgers.
The safeguarded-compact branch gives the opened process a durable juridical form.
The beginning-that-opens-what-follows branch frames the pledge as an entry point with consequences still unfolding.
The judgment-that-releases-closure branch adds adjudication to the opening and anticipates the focus verse's two consequence paths.

structural_cues: 48:1 doubles the opening root in verb and cognate noun before the focus verse.
48:10 itself doubles both pledge and breach, then divides breach and fulfillment into opposed outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening at the pericope's start and a bifurcating covenant in the focus; I infer that the first can frame the second as a threshold and adjudicative mechanism. A live alternative is that 48:1's opening names only victory and does not specify the pledge's function.

changed_reading.before: The pledge responds to an opening or victory already granted.
changed_reading.after: The pledge may itself be a threshold into what the opening releases, with fidelity and breach becoming the two adjudicated paths through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding assignment of the addressee as sent messenger and present, knowledgeable witness revises the mediated-exchange baseline. His hand can be the public point at which allegiance is witnessed and transmitted, while إِنَّمَا locates the transaction's ultimate binding counterpart in God.

activation_trace.role: The allegiance branch supplies the binding act received through the second-person addressee.
The messenger-and-message branch supplies an authorized transmitting office rather than an independent terminal counterparty.
The present-observation branch makes the public pledge an event received under witness.
The testimony-from-knowledge branch gives the messenger's presence an evidentiary function in the transaction.

structural_cues: 48:8 names the second-person addressee through commissioned roles before 48:10 addresses him as pledge recipient.
48:10 repeats the same pledge verb on both sides of restrictive إِنَّمَا while changing only the object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger and witness roles plus the focus's object-switch; I infer an authorized witness-interface between visible act and ultimate bond. The live alternative is that witness is only one role among several and should not define the pledge mechanism by itself.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is the human counterparty whose receipt is simply equated with God's receipt.
changed_reading.after: The messenger can be read as the commissioned witness-interface through whom the visible act becomes evidentially and juridically a pledge to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse exposes speech on tongues that is absent from hearts, then closes with God's knowledge of action. That three-channel mismatch sharpens the focus's reflexive breach: a hand can perform allegiance while tongue, heart, and subsequent deed fail to cohere, so نكث becomes fragmentation of the acting self.

activation_trace.role: The branch that attributes deeds to hands makes the pledge gesture answerable as the pledger's own action.
The unravelling branch models loss of coherence among the self's outward and inward channels.
The self-as-own-identity branch locates that channel split in the agent rather than in the divine compact.
The bodily tongue branch supplies the explicit outward speech channel that can diverge from inward commitment.
The heart branch supplies the inward channel whose absence from speech exposes divided allegiance.
The intentional-action branch adds the subsequent deed channel by which pledged integrity is tested.

structural_cues: 48:11 follows the focus immediately and explicitly negates correspondence between tongue and heart.
48:10's hand, self, and repeated breach already form an outward-act-to-inward-consequence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hand-action in the focus and tongue/heart/action channels in 48:11; I infer that covenant integrity requires their coherence and that breach is their unravelling. A live alternative is that 48:11 diagnoses only the stay-behind speakers, without defining every possible breach in 48:10.

changed_reading.before: Breach is a later decision to cancel an earlier hand pledge.
changed_reading.after: Breach can begin as internal incoherence: hand, tongue, heart, and deed cease to constitute one pledged self, so the damage returns upon that self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wish to substitute God's speech at 48:15 and the denial of substitution in God's established path at 48:23 distinguish two levels of change. A person can undo or replace their own enacted commitment, but cannot rewrite the divine word or governing pattern; the attempted alteration therefore recoils as self-loss, exactly as عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ states.

activation_trace.role: The undoing-after-firming branch supplies the local change a breacher can actually perform.
The self-as-own-identity branch identifies what the ineffective attack on the larger order successfully alters.
The safeguarded compact branch makes covenant a preserved order against which private substitution is measured.
The image-changing branch supplies the attempted alteration of the given speech.
The intelligible-word branch identifies a determinate utterance that the would-be followers seek to change.
The running-path branch supplies the durable divine pattern that remains in force across instances.
The replacement branch contributes the explicit impossibility of installing another thing in the divine pattern's place.

structural_cues: 48:15 presents an intention to change God's speech, while 48:23 closes a repeated divine pattern with no substitution.
48:10 restricts the consequence of undoing with a second إِنَّمَا and the reflexive عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted word-change, invariant pattern, and reflexive breach; I infer that breach changes the participant's relation and constitution rather than the divine rule. A live alternative is that the two substitution passages concern separate historical directives and only analogically illuminate the focus compact.

changed_reading.before: A breacher cancels the covenant relation for both sides.
changed_reading.after: A breacher can unmake their own participation but cannot substitute a new divine word or pattern; the only successfully altered object is the breacher's own standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:18 the same pledge is located under a tree, followed by knowledge of what is in hearts, delivery of stillness, and a returned recompense in the form of a near opening. This sequence revises the hand ceremony into a coupled exterior-interior process: the bodily pledge exposes a heart-state, and divine response settles that interior before returning an outward opening.

activation_trace.role: The anatomical-hand branch anchors the model in the focus's public bodily gesture.
The repeated allegiance branch identifies 48:18 as a direct contextual realization of the focus transaction.
The disclosure-to-knower branch opens the inward state that accompanies the visible pledge.
The heart branch supplies the interior site read by the divine counterparty.
The caused-delivery branch gives the response a downward movement from divine knowledge into the pledgers.
The cessation-of-motion branch makes tranquility an actual settling of interior agitation.
The recompense-returning-to-the-worker branch links the settled heart to an answering return.
The opening-that-begins-what-follows branch renders the near recompense as access to a new outward phase.

structural_cues: 48:18 repeats the focus pledge verb and then sequences knowing, descending, settling, recompensing, and opening.
The focus moves from plural hands to the singular self, leaving room for 48:18 to disclose the heart between public act and consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct pledge recurrence followed by heart-knowledge, descent, stillness, recompense, and opening; I infer a causal response chain from sincere interior state to settled capacity and outward consequence. A live alternative is that these are coordinated favors without a strict causal order.

changed_reading.before: The hand pledge is complete as a public legal act, with reward deferred until later fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: The hand pledge is an exterior interface to an interior settlement: the heart is known and steadied, and that steadiness begins to return as opened capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated scenes of hands being restrained at 48:20 and 48:24 make divine superordination operational as limitation of reciprocal force. The following avoidance of trampling unknown believers and admission into mercy gives that restraint a protective object. The hand above can therefore govern by stopping hands, not only by making one side's hands prevail.

activation_trace.role: The sovereign-hand branch supplies the superordinate agency whose mode of rule is revised by the context.
The ascendancy branch anchors the reading in effective control rather than decorative verticality.
The restraint-and-prevention branch supplies the first explicit operation performed upon human hands.
The anatomical-hand branch makes the restrained object the same bodily agency displayed in the focus pledge.
The repeated prevention branch extends restraint symmetrically across both opposed parties.
The two hand occurrences provide the reciprocal human force that is held within a higher limit.
The crushing-pressure branch names the collateral injury that unrestrained advance could inflict.
The mercy-and-tenderness branch supplies the protective end served by restraining superior power.

structural_cues: 48:20 restrains people's hands; 48:24 restrains each side's hands from the other; 48:25 states an unseen collateral-risk condition.
The focus's singular hand above plural hands provides a compact spatial model for control over distributed human agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hand-restraint and a following risk of inadvertent crushing; I infer that superior control is exercised to bound violence and protect hidden members of the community. A live alternative is that the restraint is purely tactical victory-management, with mercy only a separate consequence.

changed_reading.before: The hand above chiefly guarantees that the pledged side has superior force.
changed_reading.after: The hand above can signify governance that limits every human hand, including allied hands, so that victory does not become uncontrolled injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:26 heated group pride is countered by descended stillness and an adhered word of protection. This relocates covenant fidelity from raw solidarity of hands to durable attachment to a regulating utterance under affective pressure. The fulfilled عهد is thus enacted when composure keeps the pledged community fastened to a protective norm.

activation_trace.role: The repeated-care branch supplies durable covenant maintenance beyond the original hand event.
The complete-performance branch makes steadfast attachment under pressure a mode of fulfilling the compact.
The heated-pride and anger branch supplies the affective force that threatens pledged coherence.
The loss-of-motion branch supplies composure as the counterforce to heated impulsion.
The lasting-attachment branch makes the regulating word something the believers remain fastened to.
The intelligible-utterance branch gives covenant maintenance a verbal norm rather than a merely affective group bond.
The harm-deflecting protection branch supplies the adhered word's function under provocation.

structural_cues: 48:26 opposes the heated impulse placed in one set of hearts to tranquility descended on the messenger and believers.
The same verse then uses causative attachment with a singular word, giving stillness a durable verbal form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provocation, settling, attachment, word, and protection; I infer that the attached protective word channels tranquility into covenant-keeping conduct. reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Allegiance as an exchange enacted by hands.** `يبايعونك` anchors ب ي ع B003 (pledge of allegiance) while retaining B001 (exchange for a price); `يد` anchors ي د ي B005 (authority), B007 (hand-to-hand transfer), and B009 (one’s act). The doubled pledge and stacked hands make transfer and authority structural rather than ornamental. I infer that allegiance transfers committed action under higher authority in return for promised recompense. The pledge reads as a consequential transaction, not verbal affiliation.
2. **Breaking as material unraveling; fulfillment as fullness.** `نكث` anchors ن ك ث B001 (undoing what was twisted) and B002 (breaking covenant), while `أوفى` anchors و ف ي B001 (complete fullness) and `عاهد` anchors ع ه د B003. The ayah sets unraveling against completion. I infer that repeated acts twist a durable social bond and breach reverses that work. Covenant failure becomes self-dismantling; fidelity completes the bond without shortfall.
3. **The hand is audited by the hidden self.** `نفسه` anchors ن ف س B011 (living self), B012 (the very thing itself), and B013 (hidden intent). The move from public hands to the self anticipates 48:11’s tongues/hearts contrast and 48:18’s known hearts. I infer that inward intent determines where the outward act’s consequence returns. The ceremony is public, but its liability is irreducibly personal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:18 replays the pledge under a tree and explicitly joins it to known hearts, validating the hand/self mechanism. Ayah 48:29 scales that bond into mutual support while returning reward to enacted trust.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Allegiance as an exchange whose stake is the self.** Fixed doubled `يُبَايِعُون` anchors ب ي ع `B003` (pledge of allegiance) and coexistently `B001` (exchange for a price); `يَد ... أَيْدِيهِمْ` activates ي د ي `B007`, hand-to-hand transfer. Reward closes the fixed ayah, and 48:15 exposes people who want to follow only when gains are available. The packet supplies transaction, transfer, recompense, and opportunistic appetite; I infer **self committed in exchange -> reward for fulfilment / self-loss through breach**. The commercial branch does not replace allegiance; it makes its cost structure visible.

2. **Breach as material unweaving.** Fixed `نَكَثَ ... يَنكُثُ` anchors ن ك ث `B001`, "undoing what was firmly twisted or woven," and `B002`, breaking a binding covenant; fixed `أَوْفَى` anchors و ف ي `B001`, complete fullness without shortfall. Joined hands supply the material analogy. I infer **interlaced commitments -> a load-bearing bond; pulling one's strand out -> damage borne by that strand's owner**. The reflexive consequence `عَلَى نَفْسِهِ` reads as the mechanics of self-unbinding, sharpened by 48:11's divided speech and 48:15's attempted word-substitution.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 48:11 revealed how a strand may separate internally before it is publicly broken. Ayah 48:15 then supplied both gain-seeking and attempted substitution of prior speech, confirming the exchange reading and making covenantal unweaving more than a material metaphor.

baseline.text: Sana bağlılık sözü verenler, aslında Allah'a bağlılık sözü verirler. Allah'ın eli onların ellerinin üzerindedir. Kim sözünden dönerse yalnızca kendi aleyhine dönmüş olur. Kim de Allah'a verdiği sözü yerine getirirse Allah ona büyük bir ödül verecektir.

findings.text: Bağlılık yemini, kişinin eylemini daha yüksek bir yetkiye devrettiği ve karşılığında sonuç üstlendiği gerçek bir alışveriş yapısı taşır.
Yemini bozmak, birlikte örülmüş bağı sökerek kişinin kendi payını dağıtmasıdır; sadakat ise bağı eksiksiz hâle getirir.
Açıkta birleşen ellerin değeri, gizli niyetle belirlendiği için tören kamusal olsa da sorumluluğun dönüş noktası kişinin kendi iç benliğidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The pledge is simultaneously submission and exchange. Hand contact performs the transfer, while the covenant and warranty motifs assign continuing liability to the one who has entered it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Verilen dal ifadesi, bir seyin bedel karsiliginda el degistirmesini hem satan hem alan taraf acisindan anlatir. Yardimci cerceve de bu ticari degisimi, satilan seyi, iki tarafli taraf adlarini ve alis-satis fiillerini bu cekirdege bagli tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tamamlanmis veya kurulmus bedelli degisim esastir; yalnizca satisa sunma, baglilik sozu ve Hristiyan ibadet evi anlamlari disaridadir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın alis-satis adlarini hem de belirli kalip kullanimlari kapsar; tanim, kaliba ozgu okumayi butun dala genellestirmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyin, bedel denen karsilikla el degistirdigi ticari islemdir; bakis acisina gore satma veya satin alma diye adlandirilabilir. Bu cercevede satilan sey, satici ve alici taraflari, alis-satis eylemi ve buna bagli sozlesme ya da islem adlari yer alir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, bir malin veya seyin bedel karsiliginda verilmesi ve karsiligin alinmasidir.
Ayni degisim, alici tarafindan bakildiginda satin alma diye de adlandirilabilir.
Satilan sey, satici-alici ikilisi, ticaret mallari ve karsilikli alisveris adlari bu islemin bagli kullanimlaridir.
Baskasinin alisi uzerine araya girip satin almamayi bildiren kalip, cekirdegin belirli bir ticaret ortami icindeki kullanimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalin merkezinde bedel ile satilan sey arasindaki karsilikli degisimi verir. Ayni kok ailesinin kimi kullanimlarda satma, kimi kullanimlarda satin alma yonunu adlandirdigi ve taraf, nesne, islem ve ticaret mallari adlarina uzandigi ortak bicimde desteklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Zamanı el sahibiymiş gibi anlatan özel bir sözde, bütün zaman boyunca sürmeyi veya hiçbir zaman gerçekleşmemeyi belirtir.

facets.statement: Zamanın bütünü boyunca uzanan süre çekirdek anlamdır.
Olumsuz bir cümlede bu süre, bir şeyin hiçbir zaman yapılmayacağını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zamanın eli sözünü zamanın uzayıp giden süresi ve sonsuzluk olarak açıklar; olumsuz kullanımda bu, bir işin hiçbir zaman yapılmaması sonucunu verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sürenin bütün zamana yayıldığı veya bir işin hiçbir zaman olmayacağı özel söz için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Uzun süre ve sonsuzluk kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir durumun bütün zaman boyunca sürmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zamanın sonuna kadar sürme anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumsuz cümlede bir işin gelecekte hiçbir vakit yapılmayacağını bildirirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumsuz cümledeki sonsuz süre sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nesneye bağlanan eli tutacak, uç, giysinin artan parçası, kol ve destek gibi birkaç benzetmeli parça için kullanır. Dal nesnenin elde tutulabilir veya dışa uzanan parçası olarak korunabilir, ancak bu farklı parçalar tek bir değişmez biçime indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, nesneye göre tutacak, uç, uzantı, giysi kolu veya destek olabilir; bunların hepsi aynı fiziksel parça türü sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım nesneye bağlanan el sözünü kendi örnekleriyle sınırlar; tutacak, uç, uzantı ve giysi kolu yönlerini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneye bağlanan el sözü, o nesnenin tutulmaya yarayan sapını, dışa uzanan ucunu, artan bölümünü, giysi kolunu veya destek parçasını anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin tutulabilen veya elde kavranan sapı temel benzetme yönüdür.
Yayın ucu, giysinin artan parçası ve gömleğin kolu dışa uzanan bölüm olarak adlandırılır.
Bir dayanağın eli sözü, nesnenin destek veren veya işlevsel parçasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt nesneye ait eli, balta sapı ve yay ucu gibi işlevsel parçalarla; giysinin artan bölümü, gömlek kolu ve dayanak parçası gibi uzantılarla açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: bir nesnenin tutacağı, ucu ya da uzantısı
concept_gloss.applicability: Nesneye göre sap, uç, artan parça, giysi kolu veya destek işlevi gören bölümü kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Tutacak, uç, uzantı ve destek çeşitliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Balta gibi elde kavranan bir nesnenin tutulacak bölümünden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin elde kavranan sap işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın ucu, giysinin artan bölümü veya gömlek kolu gibi dışa uzanan parçalar için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin dışa uzanan parça türlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sapın yanında uç, giysi kolu, artan bölüm ve destek parçasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özel bir eğri aracın yalnızca elde tutulan sap ve kavrama bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir aracın elde kavranan tutacak bölümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Tutacak yönünde örtüşürler; odak dal çok farklı nesnelerin uç ve uzantılarına da yayılırken komşu dal tek bir aracın kavrama parçasıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tutacak ve işlevsel destek parçasını da kapsar, yalnız son uçla sınırlı değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan kuyruğunu ve bir şeyin ardında kalan son bölümünü merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün dışa uzanan veya uçta kalan bölümünü adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın uzantısı kavrama, destek veya kol işlevi görebilir; komşu dal ise kuyruk benzeri arka ve son parçayı temel alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi özel niteleme biçimini hem yaşam hem giysi için doğrudan geniş diye açıklar. Dalın genişlik ve rahatlık çevresindeki kimliği bu iki bağlı kullanımı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca yaşamı veya giysiyi niteleyen özel biçimde ortaya çıkar; giysinin eli denilen fiziksel uzantıyla karıştırılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genişlik anlamını yalnızca yaşam ve giysiyle kurulan özel nitelemelere bağlar; yalın köke ya da nesne uzantısı dalına yaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaşamı veya giysiyi niteleyen özel kullanımlarda geniş, bol ve rahat olmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Dar veya kısıtlı olmama, genişlik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Yaşam için kullanıldığında geçim ve yaşayışın geniş ve rahat olmasını belirtir.
Giysi için kullanıldığında kumaşın veya kesimin bol olmasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel niteleme biçimini genişlik anlamında birleştirir; bu genişlik hem rahat bir yaşamı hem de bol bir giysiyi niteleyebilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaşamın geniş ve rahat, giysinin ise bol olduğunu bildiren iki özel niteleme için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşam ve giysideki genişlik ile rahatlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geçimin veya yaşayışın dar ve sıkıntılı olmadığını anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamın geniş ve rahat olması anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir giysinin dar olmayıp geniş kesildiğini bildiren bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Giysinin bol ve geniş olması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genişliği yalnız yaşam ve giysiyi niteleyen özel biçimlerde anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Giysi, zırh, beden, su, verme ve yayılma gibi çok sayıda alanda genişlik ve bolluğu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yaşamın veya giysinin geniş ve bol olmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iki özel nitelemeyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise genişlik ve bolluğu çok daha fazla varlık ve duruma uygulayan geniş bir alandır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; hem yaşam hem giysi genişliğini paylaşan en yakın aday seçildi, yalnız zenginlik veya yalnız beden genişliği bildirenler elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: السعة في العيش أو الثوب في قولهم عيش يدي وثوب يدي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس يد الثوب بمعنى ما فضل منه ولا المرأة الصناعية

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkek veya kadın için kullanılan türemiş nitelemeyi eliyle iş yapmada becerikli diye açıklar. Dalın el becerisi ve ustalık çevresindeki kimliği kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel güç veya giysi genişliği değildir; kişinin eliyle iş üretmedeki becerisini niteleyen biçimdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kaynakta verilen yalın niteleme biçimini doğrudan eliyle iş yapmada becerikli kişi olarak açıklar ve özel sözlerden ek anlam taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi eliyle yaptığı işlerde becerikli, üretken ve işin gereklerini iyi bilen biri olarak niteler.

facets.statement: El emeğine dayanan bir işi iyi yapabilme becerisi çekirdek anlamdır.
Niteleme kadın veya erkek için kullanılabilir ve cinsiyetten bağımsız iş becerisini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar türemiş kişi nitelemesini, kadın veya erkek ayrımı olmaksızın eliyle iş yapmada becerikli ve üretken olma biçiminde ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: El emeğine dayalı bir işi ustaca yapan kişiyi nitelemek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: El işi becerisi ve kişiyi niteleme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin el emeği isteyen işleri kolay ve düzgün yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin el işi becerisini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin kişi özelliği olarak açıkça çözülmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İş üretme becerisi taşıyan kişi anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişiyi özellikle eliyle iş üretmedeki becerisine göre niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İşi sağlam yapma, konuşmada hazır cevaplılık, güzel anlatım ve iyi atış gibi daha geniş beceri türlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir işi iyi, düzgün ve becerikli biçimde yapmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal el emeği ve kişi niteliğiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise el işinin ötesinde konuşma ve başka uygulamalara uzanan genel ustalığı kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel ustalıkla el işi becerisi arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren aday yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli ortak söz ve destek birliği, yardım, haksızlığı önleme, dostluk ve koruyuculuk anlamlarıyla verir. Dalın birlik içinde destek ve koruma olarak kurulması bu öğelerin ortak çekirdeğini doğru taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sahiplik veya beden organı değildir; kişilerin bir araya gelerek destek, koruma ve ortak duruş sağlamasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım destek ve birlik anlamını yalnızca verilen el yapılarına bağlar; topluluk dayanışması ile bireysel destekçilik yönlerini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kişilerin başkalarına karşı ortak bir duruşta birleşmesini, birbirine yardım etmesini, haksızlığı önlemesini veya birinin destekçisi ve koruyucusu olmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Ortak söz ve ortak destekle tek güç gibi davranma çekirdek anlamdır.
Yardım etme ve haksızlığı önleme, ortak desteğin koruyucu uygulamalarıdır.
Bir kişinin başkasının eli sayılması, onun yakını, destekçisi ve koruyucusu olmasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eli ortak duruş ve destek birliğiyle ilişkilendirir; yardım, haksızlığa engel olma ve bir kişinin yanında duran koruyucu olma bu çekirdeğin başlıca yönleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toplulukların ortak duruşunu, karşılıklı yardımı ve bir kişinin koruyucu destekçi oluşunu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Birlik, yardım, destek ve koruma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun başkalarına karşı ortak söz ve destekle hareket ettiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak duruş ve birleşik destek anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birinin yanında duran yakın yardımcısı olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bireysel destekçilik ve koruyuculuk anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak sözle tek güç olmayı, haksızlığı önlemeyi ve birinin koruyucusu olmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yardım isteme, yardım etme ve belirli bir iş üzerinde birlikte çalışma süreçlerini daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişilerin birbirine yardım etmesini ve ortak bir işte destek vermesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal birlik halinde karşı durma ve koruyuculuğu öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise yardımın istenmesi, verilmesi ve birlikte çalışma biçimlerini daha geniş kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birlikte hareket etme, haksızlığı önleme ve bireysel koruyuculuk eylemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin güç aldığı yardımcılar ve destekçi topluluğun kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin veya topluluğun destekçilerle güç kazanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal destek ve koruma ilişkisini anlatır; komşu dal ise bu desteği sağlayan insan topluluğunu adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli koyma buyruğunu doğrudan yemek anlamında açıklar. Dalın yemek eylemine başlama olarak kurulması tek ve açık kanıtı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca bu buyurma sözünde ortaya çıkar; beden organını tek başına adlandırmaz ve açlık durumu bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yemek anlamını yalnızca eli koymayı söyleyen buyurma yapısına bağlar ve yalın el sözcüğüne genellemez.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrudan yemek buyruğunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Buyruğun el hareketinden çok yemek eylemine yöneldiğinin açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yemek eylemine başlama yönlendirmesini korur.
